title: The Big Short (2015) - FrontPoint Partners confronts Morgan Stanley Risk Assessors and S&P
summary: A five-minute clip from The Big Short (2015) in which FrontPoint Partners confront Morgan Stanley risk assessors and an S&P ratings representative about inflated mortgage bond ratings.
